chunks: Then We punished them. So look at the fate of those who denied.
ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those who denied the truth according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the inevitable collapse of tyrannical regimes that reject divine guidance, serving as a historical precedent for the faithful. It underscores the concept of 'Izzah' (divine honor) being transferred from the arrogant to the humble, reinforcing the belief that ultimate victory belongs to those who remain steadfast in truth.
